title: elymus multiflorus subsp. kingianus
intro: Elymus multiflorus subsp. kingianus, commonly known as Chinese wildrye, is a subspecies of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidant, and anti-bacterial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chinese wildrye include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
